items.title: Walter Booker and Jimmy Cobb interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995
items.q: He probably felt more comfortable up there, not because of his knowledge, just because of his ears

ctx.x: Some people say that he played the tenor so high because he really still heard the sounds from the alto, like he was playing everything a fourth up higher.
He probably felt more comfortable up there, not because of his knowledge, just because of his ears, and what made him feel comfortable, you know?
Give us a quick chronology of who you think some of the bass lineage is. We talked about Hawkins and Prez and Bird and Trane. Give us some of that bass chronology then.
